header.description: What: CE-11061 (DESIGN_Injury_States.md §9) - REVIVE. One Rifleman (Friend) advances on test-town toward (325,300), about 74 m from one Armed Hostile who stands still. At 10 s the check kills the Rifleman (Health 0: he drops, stops moving and firing); at 20 s it REVIVES him - the Unit form's Revive button, the same edit-framework op (POST /entities/{id}/revive): full health, wounds and stun cleared, move and fire given back. Judge: (1) the healthy man fights before he is killed; (2) dead, he fires no shot until revived; (3) revived, he is at full health and can move and fire again, and he is alive at the end. Fail: he shoots while dead, or after the revive he stays at 0, or stays without move / fire. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh ua-revive
